description: High-contrast theme configured through vim.g.sonokai_* globals (no setup() API).
author: sainnhe
tagline: Vibrant high-contrast palette with six styles

options.label: Global Configuration Lua
options.description: Sonokai uses vim.g.sonokai_* globals. Edit this block to customize before applying the colorscheme.
options.default:
vim.g.sonokai_style = 'default'
vim.g.sonokai_better_performance = 0
vim.g.sonokai_enable_italic = 0
vim.g.sonokai_disable_italic_comment = 0
vim.g.sonokai_cursor = 'auto'
vim.g.sonokai_transparent_background = 0
vim.g.sonokai_dim_inactive_windows = 0
vim.g.sonokai_disable_terminal_colors = 0
